headline: Last session: Nifty and Sensex extend winning streak to 4 weeks despite global AI sell-off pressures

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Wednesday, 25 November.

why: Indian stock market benchmarks Nifty 50 and Sensex extended their winning streak to 4 consecutive weeks, logging around 3% gains.
Record FII buying helped push the Sensex and Nifty 50 to 9-month highs during the week.
Early session pullbacks occurred due to global sell-offs in AI stocks and hawkish rate hike signals from the US Fed.
Midday support from Banking, Auto, and IT sectors fueled recovery during volatile trading sessions.
whatHappening: Maha FDA suspended Pune dark store operations of Amazon and BigBasket over safety violations.
India and Finland announced plans to deepen bilateral economic ties through startup ecosystem cooperation.
Gold prices fell to their lowest level of 2026, while Bitcoin dropped to a two-year low.
NSE unlisted stock price rallied 5% on strong trading volume, marking a 35% rebound from its October low.
summary: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty 50 wrapped up a robust week, extending their winning streak to four weeks with a 3% gain despite underperformance in smallcaps. Early trading pressure caused by a global AI stock sell-off and US Fed rate hike concerns was countered by strong midday buying in banking, auto, and IT shares. Meanwhile, Maharashtra FDA suspended dark store operations of Amazon and BigBasket in Pune due to safety non-compliance.
